Decision.description: Decider's answer to one typed question about one chunk or one proposed tool call.

subject_id.description: Chunk.id, or the Strands toolUseId of the tool call.
subject_id.title: Subject Id

question.description: Key of the typed question, e.g. 'instructs_ai'.
question.title: Question

label.description: The chosen answer: 'true' or 'false' for noul, the option name for choice, the nearest level for score.
label.title: Label

confidence.description: Decider's normalized confidence, (N * p_max - 1) / (N - 1): 0 means a uniform guess, 1 means certain. For noul this is |2p - 1|.
confidence.title: Confidence

probabilities.description: Probability of every option. For noul: {'true': p, 'false': 1 - p}.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

Decision.title: Decision

description: What the guardrail does with a chunk or a tool call, and why.

type.description: 'proceed': let it through. 'guide': let the model retry with feedback. 'confirm': ask the user first (tool calls only). 'deny': block it.
type.title: Type

reason.description: Why, for logs and metrics. Never shown to the model.
reason.title: Reason

message.description: Text for whoever acts next: feedback to the model for 'guide', the question to the user for 'confirm', the replacement or cancellation text for 'deny'. Null for 'proceed'.
message.title: Message

decisions.description: The decisions this action was based on.
decisions.title: Decisions

title: Action
